content: Tamikalan ni coe e râw hoi tamikathout ni coe e rawk kahmanae

content.text: Thoenae kasaknaw kecu dawk lungmathoe hoi awm hanh awh.
Payonnae kasaknaw hai ut awh hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, phokahring patetlah palang kamyai awh vaiteh,
anhna kahring patetlah palang a due awh han.
BAWIPA kâuep nateh, hawinae hah sak haw.
Ram thung awm nateh, yuemkamcunae hah hringkhaih.
BAWIPA dawk konawm haw.
Na lungngai e hah na poe han.
Na lamthung hah BAWIPA koe poe haw,
ama kâuep haw, ama ni a sak han.
Na lannae teh angnae patetlah tâcawt sak vaiteh,
na kângingnae hah kanîthun patetlah ao sak han.
BAWIPA dawk kâhat nateh, lungsaw laihoi ring haw.
Amamae lamthung dawk tânae kahmawtnaw kecu dawk thoseh,
thoenae a noe e naw dawk a kâvoe awh kecu dawk thoseh,
na lungmathout hanh.
Na lungphuen sak hanh,
lungkhueknae cettakhai haw.
Lungmathoe hoi awm hanh.
Hot ni teh, hawihoehnae koe doeh na hrawi.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, thoenae kasaknaw teh, raphoe lah ao awh han.
Hatei, BAWIPA ka ngaihawi e naw ni, talai heh râw lah a coe awh han.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, tamikathoutnaw teh dongdengca dawk awm awh mahoeh toe.
Bokheiyah, a onae hmuen koe kahawicalah na tawng han,
hatei, awm mahoeh toe.
Hatei, a lungkanem e ni talai râw a coe vaiteh,
kapap e roumnae dawk a lunghawi awh han.
Tamikathout ni tamikalan a youk teh,
a hâkam a kata sin.
Hatei, Bawipa ni tamikathout teh a panui sin.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimae hnin ka tho hane hah a panue.
Mathoe hoi kavoutthoupnaw kamlei sak hane hoi,
kalan lah kahringnaw thei hanelah,
tamikathoutnaw ni amamae tahloi sut a rayu awh teh,
licung sut a sawn awh toe.
Hatei, amamae tahloi teh amamae lung dawk kâen vaiteh,
ahnimae licung teh khoe lah ao han.
Tamikathout ni tawnta e hlak,
tamikalan ni younca a tawn e ahawihnawn.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, tamikathout e kut teh khoe lah awm vaiteh,
tamikalan e kut teh BAWIPA ni a kabawp han.
BAWIPA ni tamikalannaw e hnin a panue pouh teh,
a coe awh e râw teh a yungyoe kangning e doeh.
Ahnimouh teh, atueng mathoe nahaiyah,
yeirai phawt awh mahoeh.
Takang tue nahaiyah, a von a paha awh han.
Hatei, tamikathout teh a kahma han.
BAWIPA e tarannaw teh,
ka sungren e phokahring patetlah kahmat awh vaiteh,
hmaikhu lah a pâyam awh vaiteh a kahma awh han.
Tamikathout niteh, a cawi e patho hoeh toe.
Hatei, tamikalan niteh, a pahren teh a poe.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, yawhawi poe lah kaawmnaw ni
talai râw a coe awh han.
Thoebo lah kaawmnaw teh raphoe lah ao awh han.
Tamikalannaw e khoktabei teh BAWIPA ni a caksak teh,
a ceinae lamthung hah a ngai pouh.
A tâlaw nakunghai, poutnae koe phat mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni ahnie kut a kuet pouh.
Thoundoun lah ka o teh ka matawng toe.
Tamikalan ceitakhai e ka hmawt boihoeh.
A ca catounnaw kutdaw lah ao e ka hmawt boihoeh.
Ayâ a lungma teh, a cawi sak dawkvah,
a ca catounnaw teh yawhawinae a coe awh.
Yonnae cettakhai nateh, hawinae sak nateh,
hete ram dawk pou awm haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni kângingnae hah a lungpataw.
A tamikathoungnaw cettakhai boihoeh.
Lungmawng lah pou ao sak.
Tamikalan ni ram heh râw lah a coe vaiteh,
a thung vah kho pou a sak awh han.
Tamikalan e pahni ni lungangnae lawk a dei teh,
a lai ni kângingnae hah a pâpho.
A Cathut e kâlawk teh a lungthin thung ao dawkvah,
a cei toteh tâlaw mahoeh.
Tamikathout ni tamikalan a pawp teh,
thei hanelah ouk a tawng.
Hatei, BAWIPA ni ahnie kut dawk tamikalan hah tâkhawng mahoeh.
Lawkceng lah ao nakunghai yonpen lah awm mahoeh.
BAWIPA hah ring haw.
A lamthung hah dawn haw.
Hete ram coe hanelah, na tawmrasang han.
Tamikathoutnaw koung raphoe lah ao e hah na hmu han.
Tamikathout hoi tamitongthoenaw teh, ung e thingkung patetlah,
hluthlut a naw awh e hah ka hmu toe.
Hatei, a due teh, khenhaw! ahni teh awm hoeh toe.
Bokheiyah, ka tawng eiteh, hmu hane awm hoeh toe.
Kuepnae hah pouk nateh, lannae hah lueplueppouk haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, hmâ lah a coe hane teh,
lungmawngnae doeh.
Hatei, tamikayonnaw teh,
koung raphoe lah awm vaiteh,
tamikathoutnaw ni a coe hane haiyah,
raphoenae hah doeh.
Tamikalan rungngangnae teh, BAWIPA koehoi doeh.
Ahni teh runae tueng nah kânguenae im doeh.
BAWIPA ni kabawm vaiteh, a rungngang han.
Ama a kâuep dawkvah, tamikathoutnaw thung hoi
a rasa teh ouk a rungngang.
